decision_runtime: numpy (learned_judgment.students.snn_core); torch was used for training only

dream.score_spread_rows: training rows (null under target_spread 'per_row': each row uses its own)
dream.split: by distinct situation (learned_judgment.students.snn.split_rows_by_situation): rows with identical situations are all training rows or all early-stopping rows

training_row_spread.definition: population std of each training row's dreamed scores across its candidates

early_stopping_rows_in_dream.label: inside the dream, on the early-stopping rows: the optimiser never trained on them, but they chose the restored weights, so these numbers are optimistic and NOT held out
early_stopping_rows_in_dream.spread_definition: median population std of the training rows' scores (dream.training_row_spread)

label: dream-trained spiking student: trained to choose the candidate the dream scores best; every number here is measured inside the dream, not in the simulator; the numbers under 'early_stopping_rows_in_dream' come from the rows that chose the restored weights, so they are not held-out numbers

parity.rows: every training and early-stopping row of the dream

candidate_grid.definition: sha256 over b'learned-judgment/candidate-grid/v1', points_per_dim, and for each probe situation the shape and float64 bytes of spec.candidate_actions(situation, points_per_dim) (-0.0 written as 0.0)

situation_variables.description: ball centre x relative to the base, in the dog's heading frame at the decision instant (x forward, y left, z up, origin at the base)
situation_variables.name: ball_rel_x_m

situation_variables.description: ball centre y relative to the base, in the dog's heading frame at the decision instant (x forward, y left, z up, origin at the base)
situation_variables.name: ball_rel_y_m

situation_variables.description: ball centre z relative to the base, in the dog's heading frame at the decision instant (x forward, y left, z up, origin at the base)
situation_variables.name: ball_rel_z_m

situation_variables.description: ball velocity along x, in the dog's heading frame at the decision instant (x forward, y left, z up, origin at the base)
situation_variables.name: ball_vel_x_m_s

situation_variables.description: ball velocity along y, in the dog's heading frame at the decision instant (x forward, y left, z up, origin at the base)
situation_variables.name: ball_vel_y_m_s

situation_variables.description: ball velocity along z, in the dog's heading frame at the decision instant (x forward, y left, z up, origin at the base)
situation_variables.name: ball_vel_z_m_s

situation_variables.description: forward speed the dog trots at before the decision instant; sent as 'vel_x' for the whole episode
situation_variables.name: dog_forward_speed_m_s

situation_variables.description: payload mass the world declares (a label that can be wrong; never the true mass)
situation_variables.name: declared_payload_kg

situation_variables.description: floor type the world declares (a label; never its friction)
situation_variables.name: declared_surface

situations_seen.definition: sha256 over b'learned-judgment/situation/v1', b'float64:<S>' and the S float64 values of the situation (-0.0 written as 0.0); identical situations have identical digests

training.acceptance: the restored weights must have a total validation KL below initialisation, a validation KL per head below that of the head's mean training target (the best constant prediction), and spikes in every hidden layer on the validation rows; otherwise fit raises TrainingError
training.loss: per head KL(target || softmax(logits)) averaged over that head's rows, weighted by the head's share of the batch, plus spike_rate_penalty x mean hidden firing rate; early stopping on the sampling-weighted validation KL
